- **self**: Aggregation binary hashing and hashed-index key separation (17/4)

## How it works

- [statement] Applications do not need to precompute hashes to use a hashed index: MongoDB computes the hashes when resolving indexed queries. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-hashed.md · keywords: Aggregation binary hashing and hashed-index key separation
- [statement] Hashed indexes automatically compute hashes when resolving queries; applications do not need to precompute a $hash digest. Use $toHashedIndexKey for aggregation-side index-hash calculation, or convertShardKeyToHashed() in the shell. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-hashed.md · keywords: Aggregation binary hashing and hashed-index key separation · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/toHashedIndexKey.md

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] $hash returns null for null, undefined, or missing input. For other inputs, a value that is neither a valid UTF-8 string nor BinData produces an error. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/hash.md · keywords: Aggregation binary hashing and hashed-index key separation
- [statement] An algorithm value outside the accepted set produces a $hash error. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/hash.md · keywords: Aggregation binary hashing and hashed-index key separation
- [statement] $hash raises an error for other input types or an unrecognized algorithm. A numeric or document value therefore needs an explicit application-defined representation before general-purpose hashing. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/hash.md · keywords: Aggregation binary hashing and hashed-index key separation
- [statement] Percona lists $hash among the new expressions in its own Percona Server for MongoDB 8.3 Technical Preview announcement dated July 30, 2026. This supports distribution adoption, without independently verifying input/error behavior. (low confidence) — https://www.percona.com/blog/percona-server-for-mongodb-8-3-technical-preview-is-now-available/ · keywords: Aggregation binary hashing and hashed-index key separation

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] $toHashedIndexKey does not apply collation to strings, even under a non-simple aggregation collation. A hashed index can hash a collation key instead, so its hash can differ from the expression result for the same data. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/toHashedIndexKey.md · keywords: Aggregation binary hashing and hashed-index key separation · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-84462

## Facts and statements

- [statement] MongoDB documents $hash as new in 8.3; Percona also includes $hash among the aggregation expressions in its 8.3 technical preview. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-07-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/hash.md · keywords: Aggregation binary hashing and hashed-index key separation · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/percona-server-for-mongodb-8-3-technical-preview-is-now-available/
- [statement] $hash computes a BinData digest from a valid UTF-8 string or BinData; $hexHash is the corresponding hexadecimal-string form. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/hash.md · keywords: Aggregation binary hashing and hashed-index key separation · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/COMPASS-10200
- [statement] The syntax is { $hash: { input: <expression>, algorithm: <string> } }; both fields are required, and input must resolve to a valid UTF-8 string or BinData, apart from the documented nullish cases. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/hash.md · keywords: Aggregation binary hashing and hashed-index key separation
- [statement] For null or a missing input field, $hash returns null; $toHashedIndexKey instead hashes null and missing values to a Long. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/hash.md · keywords: Aggregation binary hashing and hashed-index key separation · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/toHashedIndexKey.md
- [statement] $toHashedIndexKey uses MongoDB hashed-index hashing and returns a fixed-size numeric hash, whereas $hash is a general-purpose binary-digest expression. The operators serve different output and key semantics. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/hash.md · keywords: Aggregation binary hashing and hashed-index key separation · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/toHashedIndexKey.md
- [statement] Hashed-index numeric semantics can collapse distinct inputs: the documented example gives 2.3, 2.2, and 2.9 the same hash after truncation to a 64-bit integer. An index hash is therefore unsuitable as a lossless identity for the original numeric value. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-hashed.md · keywords: Aggregation binary hashing and hashed-index key separation
- [statement] Migration Verifier documents that its toHashedIndexKey comparison mode can miss an equal-valued Long-to-Double type change. Hash-and-length comparison therefore does not establish full BSON binary equivalence. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb-labs/migration-verifier · keywords: Aggregation binary hashing and hashed-index key separation
- [statement] NoSQLBooster 11.1 documents a $.hash({ input: "$password", algorithm: "sha256" }) operator helper for MongoDB 8.3 aggregation; its announcement says the helper includes inline code-completion documentation. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-30) — https://nosqlbooster.com/blog/announcing-nosqlbooster-11-1/ · keywords: Aggregation binary hashing and hashed-index key separation
- [statement] MongoDB introduced $hash in 8.3 as an aggregation expression that returns a BinData digest from a UTF-8 string or binary input. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/hash.md · keywords: Aggregation binary hashing and hashed-index key separation · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/release-notes/8.3.md
- [statement] $hash returns null for null, undefined, or missing input. For null or missing values, $toHashedIndexKey instead returns a Long hash value; replacing one operator with the other changes null semantics. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/hash.md · keywords: Aggregation binary hashing and hashed-index key separation · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/toHashedIndexKey.md
